request.prompt: RimWorld creature sprite, painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background. A long, low ambush predator called the yanker, dormant in a tight, compressed coil. The coil is a narrow, elongated oval with flattened, parallel flanks and sharp straight side edges, squeezed as if between two close walls, though no walls are drawn and the background stays clean transparent alpha. The body is a wide, flat ribbon, visibly broader than it is thick: shallow, stacked, strap-like bands with a flattened cross-section and a low profile, the whole coil only a little taller than the head. A fringe of fine tactile filaments lies folded flat and close along the flanks, with the tips just reaching out at the edges. The head rests on top of the low coil: a blunt wedge-shaped head with a toothed mouth. Projecting forward from beneath the jaw is a pair of large, jointed, hooked grasping arms, like barbed mandible-claws, held low and forward beside the head, open and reaching, oversized (about a third of the head-to-coil length) so the seize-and-yank signature reads at standard zoom. The front view, the side view and the rear view show the same coil at the same height, width and bulk; only the head and arm projection changes between them. The rear view, seen from behind, shows the coil's tail end, the flat bands and the arms folded low, with the eyes hidden. The silhouette is alien, its own species: flat ribbon body, big forward grasping arms and a fringe of flank filaments. Sized to read about 2.7 cells.
